mapper.select: select count(distinct cost.bizDate) from ( select c.project_id projectId,c.biz_date bizDate from biz_project_member_day_cost c join biz_project p on p.project_id=c.project_id and p.cost_policy_version='MEMBER_DAYS_V1' where c.project_id=#{projectId} and c.biz_date between #{from} and #{to} and c.pricing_status='PRICED' and c.amount is not null union all select e.project_id projectId,e.biz_date bizDate from biz_project_work_entry e join biz_project p on p.project_id=e.project_id and p.cost_policy_version='ACTUAL_WORK_V1' join biz_project_work_cost c on c.entry_id=e.entry_id and c.pricing_status='PRICED' and c.amount is not null where e.project_id=#{projectId} and e.biz_date between #{from} and #{to} and e.status='CONFIRMED' and e.is_current='1' ) cost where not exists(select 1 from biz_project_daily_result r where r.project_id=cost.projectId and r.biz_date=cost.bizDate and r.is_current='1')

select coalesce(a.user_id,e.user_id) userId, max(coalesce(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(cost.basis,'$.userName')),'null'),cost.component_name)) userName, sum(cost.amount) amount,count(distinct cost.biz_date) workingDays, date_format(min(cost.biz_date),'%Y-%m-%d') startDate,date_format(max(cost.biz_date),'%Y-%m-%d') endDate from ( select r.project_id,r.biz_date,i.amount,i.component_name, case when json_valid(i.calculation_detail) then i.calculation_detail else '{}' end basis from biz_project_daily_result r join biz_project_daily_result_item i on i.result_id=r.result_id where r.project_id=#{projectId} and r.biz_date between #{from} and #{to} and r.is_current='1' and i.component_code='PERSONNEL_COST_PERSON' ) cost left join biz_project_staff_allocation a on a.allocation_id=cast(json_unquote(json_extract(cost.basis,'$.allocationId')) as unsigned) and a.project_id=cost.project_id left join biz_project_work_entry e on e.entry_id=cast(json_unquote(json_extract(cost.basis,'$.sourceEntryId')) as unsigned) and e.project_id=cost.project_id group by coalesce(a.user_id,e.user_id),case when coalesce(a.user_id,e.user_id) is null then cost.component_name else '' end order by amount desc,userId
select coalesce(sum(personnel_cost),0) personnelCost,count(*) resultCount from biz_project_daily_result where project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date between #{from} and #{to} and is_current='1'
